brief: Prioritise the Underhill Reach 138/13kV unit for pre-event attention ahead of younger units in similar condition, as its advanced age and high loading history leave it with a reduced margin against mechanical failure ([MG-023]). Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure ([MG-023]). Record every de-rating applied, including the reason, the value, and the period ([MG-021]).
